name: Founders Metals Inc.
summary: Founders Metals Inc. concentrates its efforts on the procurement, investigation, and subsequent advancement of gold deposits, predominantly operating from its base in Canada. The company's asset portfolio notably includes the extensive Elmtree gold project, situated in New Brunswick, which comprises 49 interconnected mineral claims spread across 1,063,326 hectares. Additionally, Founders Metals holds an interest in the Antino gold project, an area spanning 23,800 hectares located in the southeastern region of Suriname. The firm's principal place of business is located in Vancouver, Canada.
